notice: Template only. All networks are disabled. Set referenceLiquidityUsdtBaseUnits to an operator-approved USDT-equivalent pricing depth; this is a pricing reference, not a requirement to fund an external USDT payout wallet. Set a finalized demandSnapshot, positive priceFloor/priceCeiling, positive order/daily limits, feeBps (0-1000), minimumInventoryBaseUnits, and a freshly verified SOBYA verifiedPayoutInventoryBaseUnits plus inventoryObservedAtEpoch before quote creation. Never put private keys or seed phrases in this file or repository. Payout runtime is implemented behind featureEnabled and per-network enabled flags; all remain false. Store network-bound encrypted key files outside the repository and supply their passphrases through local environment variables only. Deposit verification runs in the unified custodial runtime when depositWatchEnabled and the relevant per-network depositWatchEnabled flag are explicitly true. The order/API layer must submit (order_id, transaction hash/signature, exact log/instruction index) to the durable queue; shared-wallet balance deltas are never used to infer an order; per-order unique deposit addresses are not required. Customer order UI and loopback API are available when orderApiEnabled is explicitly true; they require SOBYA_ORDER_API_ACCESS_SECRET (32+ bytes), a live quote provider with a fresh finalized demandSnapshot, verified non-zero reference depth, bounded price floor/ceiling, finalized demand snapshot, operator-approved order/daily limits and feeBps, and a fresh verified SOBYA inventory snapshot above the protected minimum reserve. The API remains disabled by default and must be exposed only through a trusted TLS reverse proxy.  Initial public order direction is USDT-to-SOBY only. A destination network must have payoutInventoryVerified=true before any quote is issued. Keep SOBY-to-USDT disabled until each selected external USDT inventory wallet has been funded and independently verified; then explicitly add that direction to enabledSwapDirections.
